question: What spatial or cosmic extent is encompassed by the described sacred domain?
premises: The extent begins from the yoni.
It reaches up to the earth.
It extends up to the realm associated with ignorance and delight.
inference: The sacred domain spans from the yoni up to the earth and to the realm of avidyāgandhamādana.
uncertainties: The precise referent of āvidyāgandhamādanam is unclear in this verse.
plain_english: From the yoni up to the earth, extending to the realm of avidyāgandhamādana.
